return.selectionHint: Approved orders go back to the warehouse, rejected ones stay where they were (with the courier or in the branch post)

dialog.note: This action can't be undone. An order that another employee has reviewed meanwhile, or whose status has changed, is skipped and shown in the result.

description.hq: Orders ({{value}}) will be taken from couriers and returned to the HQ warehouse. Their status becomes “Waiting” and they are detached from the courier and the mail.
description.branch: Orders ({{value}}) will be taken from couriers and returned to the branch warehouse. Their status becomes “Waiting” and they are detached from the courier and the mail.
description.transfer: Orders ({{value}}) did not arrive at the branch and return to the HQ warehouse. Their status becomes “Received” and they are added to the region's new mail to be sent again.
description.mixed: Orders ({{value}}) return to the warehouse: those with couriers become “Waiting” and are detached from the courier and the mail; those that did not arrive at the branch become “Received” at the HQ warehouse and are added to the region's new mail to be sent again.

errors.forbidden: Some orders are with another branch's courier — that branch reviews them. The list has been refreshed — close this window and select again.
errors.stale: The selection is out of date: the selected requests have already been reviewed or their status has changed. The list has been refreshed — close this window and select again.
errors.server: Something went wrong while approving. Some orders may already be back in the warehouse — the list has been refreshed, check it and try again.
errors.generic: Could not approve the requests. Try again a bit later.

reject.title: Reject return requests
reject.description: Requests ({{value}}) will be rejected: the orders will not return to the warehouse and stay with the courier (or in the branch mail).

errors.forbidden: Some orders are with another branch's courier — that branch reviews them. The list has been refreshed — close this window and select again.
errors.stale: The selection is out of date: the selected requests have already been reviewed or their status has changed. The list has been refreshed — close this window and select again.
errors.server: Something went wrong while rejecting. Some requests may already be rejected — the list has been refreshed, check it and try again.
errors.generic: Could not reject the requests. Try again a bit later.

result.kept: The orders stayed with the courier or in the branch mail.

result.skippedReason: {{orders}}: another employee reviewed it meanwhile or its status changed.
result.skippedReasonMany: {{orders}}: another employee reviewed them meanwhile or their status changed.
result.skippedReasonMore: {{list}} and {{value}} more: another employee reviewed them meanwhile or their status changed.
